crossRefs.note: Now Yahweh had revealed to Samuel a day before Saul came, saying,
crossRefs.keyword: told thy servant. Heb. revealed the ear of thy servant

crossRefs.note: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell…
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will…
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

parallels.note: For you, Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, have revealed to your servant, saying, ‘I will build you a house.’…

translations.web: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.
translations.bsb: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.
translations.kjv: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
translations.asv: For thou, O my God, hast revealed to thy servant that thou wilt build him a house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray before thee.
